text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While heading to the Trainer's Room 
together with Ines Fuujin—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's been hurting ever since this 
morning...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I've got my part-time job today, but... I 
wonder if I can serve the customers 
properly..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, could you play the role of a 
customer for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Welcome! What can I get for you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, hahaha! My part-time job today is at 
a fast-food joint, not a ramen shop!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ow-ow-ow...! Laughing makes my head 
throb even worse...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin was plagued by a headache for a 
while after that.
